newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks lose ground in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks lose ground in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks lost ground in lacklustre trade on Friday, with only one of the three fully-listed companies, Varazdinska Banka, bucking the trend.
* Eleven of 18 active issues fell, three rose and four were flat.
* Turnover halved at 1.5 million kuna, volume also lower at 3,640 shares.
* Top gainer was Zagreb's Intercontinental hotel, up five kuna to 270 kuna, with 100 units sold.
* Leading decliner cable maker Elka lost 19 kuna or 12.67 percent to 131 kuna, with 155 shares changing hands.
* Most active food processor Podravka inched down 0.50 kuna to 305 on volume of 1,462 shares.
